landing.heroDesc: Track income & expenses, monitor debts, create budgets, achieve financial goals together as a family — all in one app.
landing.featuresDesc: Complete features to manage family finances in one app.
landing.ctaBottomDesc: Start for free, no charges. Your data is safe and stored in the cloud.
landing.feature1Desc: Record every transaction with category, wallet, and notes. View history with filters and quick search.
landing.feature2Desc: Create Cash, Bank, or E-Wallet wallets. Transfer between wallets and monitor real-time balance.
landing.feature3Desc: Visualize finances with interactive charts. Export to PDF & CSV for archiving.
landing.feature4Desc: Create budgets per category, monitor usage. Set automatic savings targets every month.
landing.feature5Desc: Track debts/receivables with active, paid, or overdue status. Pay in installments.
landing.feature6Desc: Automatically record monthly/weekly transactions like salary, electricity bills, or routine installments.
landing.feature7Desc: Join a family group. All members can view and record transactions together.
landing.feature8Desc: Login with fingerprint, Google authentication, and data securely stored on Firebase Cloud.
landing.feature9Desc: Access from Android (Flutter) and Web (Next.js). Data stays synced in real-time without reconfiguration.

marketing.homeDesc: Empower your family with private finance workflows that scale, seamless budgeting, wallet, and reporting tools for modern households.
marketing.guideTitle: Run your family finance workflow with clarity.
marketing.guideDesc: Family Finance combines Android-first recording, family collaboration, shared budgeting, and web monitoring into one private system.
marketing.step1Desc: Register, invite family members, and keep every household account in one secure workspace.
marketing.step2Desc: Create cash, bank, or e-wallet balances, then organize spending with custom categories.
marketing.step3Desc: Record income, expenses, debt, savings, recurring entries, and transfers with clean history.
marketing.step4Desc: Monitor trends, budget discipline, and family progress from Android and companion web dashboard.
marketing.startAndroidMonitorWeb: Start from Android. Monitor from web.
marketing.downloadDesc: Install the latest APK, create or join a family, then use the web dashboard for reports, monitoring, and admin operations.

guide.title: How to Use
guide.desc: Follow these steps to start managing your family finances.
guide.step1Desc: Create a new account using email or Google. Your data is securely stored on Firebase.
guide.step1Detail1: Click 'Get Started Free' or 'Register' on the home page
guide.step1Detail2: Enter email and password, or choose 'Sign in with Google'
guide.step1Detail3: After success, you will be directed to the main page
guide.step2Desc: Create a family group or join with an invite code from another member.
guide.step2Detail1: Open the 'Family' menu in the sidebar
guide.step2Detail2: Select 'Create Family' to create a new group
guide.step2Detail3: Or enter an invite code to join an existing group
guide.step2Detail4: All members can view transactions together in real-time
guide.step3Desc: Create wallets to manage balances in different places.
guide.step3Detail1: Open the 'Wallet' menu in the bottom sidebar
guide.step3Detail2: Click the '+' button to add a new wallet
guide.step3Detail3: Choose type: Cash, Bank, or E-Wallet
guide.step3Detail4: You can transfer between wallets easily
guide.step4Desc: Record every daily transaction to monitor cash flow.
guide.step4Detail2: Select category, source wallet, enter amount and notes
guide.step4Detail4: View all history in the 'History' menu with filters and search
guide.step5Desc: Create budgets per category and automatic savings targets.
guide.step5Detail1: Open 'Budget' menu to limit expenses per category
guide.step5Detail2: Open 'Savings' menu to create savings targets
guide.step5Detail3: The 'Savings' category will automatically add to savings balance
guide.step5Detail4: Monitor budget and savings progress in real-time
guide.step6Desc: Manage debt and receivable records with status and installments.
guide.step6Detail1: Open 'Debt' menu to view all records
guide.step6Detail2: Select 'Debt' tab for debts, 'Receivable' tab for receivables
guide.step6Detail3: Each record has status: Active, Paid, or Overdue
guide.step6Detail4: You can pay in installments and view payment history
guide.step7Desc: View financial reports in charts and numbers.
guide.step7Detail1: Open 'Reports' menu to view financial summary
guide.step7Detail2: Filter by Daily, Weekly, Monthly, or Yearly
guide.step7Detail4: Export reports to PDF or CSV for archiving
guide.step8Desc: Enable fingerprint and notifications for transactions.
guide.step8Detail2: Enable fingerprint for quick and secure login
guide.step8Detail3: Enable notifications for budget reminders and transactions
guide.ctaDesc: Download the Android app or access via web to start managing your finances.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.noFamilyDesc: You haven't created or joined a family group. Please create or join a family on the Android app first, then this dashboard will display family data.

reportsPage.desc: View financial reports with charts and summaries. Filter by daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly period. Data comes from transactions recorded on the Android app.

budgetSavings.title: Budget & Savings
budgetSavings.desc: Monitor budget limits and savings targets created from the Android app. Budgets help control spending per category, savings help track financial goals.
budgetSavings.note: Data is created from the Android app. This page is read-only for monitoring.

admin.title: Admin Panel
admin.noPermission: You do not have admin access.
admin.dashboardDesc: Monitor usernames, devices, app versions, and login sources without exposing finance, email, or family member data.

home.title: Record on Android, review together on the web.
home.desc: Your family's income, spending, budgets, savings, and debts in one place. Everyone records from their own phone and sees the same numbers.
home.ctaNote: Free. Only members of your family can open your data.

overview.title: Monthly summary
overview.desc: Balance, income, spending, and remaining budget for the month on one screen.

transactions.title: Transaction history
transactions.desc: Search and filter by month, type, or category.

budget.title: Budgets and savings
budget.desc: Per-category limits, alerts when one is nearly spent, and savings goals.

privacy.title: Your family's data
privacy.desc: Access is scoped to your family through Firebase Auth and database rules.
